==Objectives==
Speak with Engineer Wigglestip and gather his report, bring it to Watcher Mahar Ba.
* [[Engineer Wigglestip's Report]]

==Description==
Why, you wouldn't happen to have some spare time would you?

The master of this tower has been hard at work and has given me the task of gathering a report from Engineer Wigglestip. Sadly to say, I haven't had the opportunity to leave just yet, nor do I know how to find our gnomish friend!

Do you think you could speak with Wigglestip and gather the report from him? Once you've obtained it, you can bring it to Watcher Mahar Ba at the top of the tower.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
*650 XP
*+25 [[reputation]] with [[Dalaran (faction)|Dalaran]]

==Progress==
Yes, can I help you?

==Completion==
So that is why you are here, this is the report from Wigglestip yes?

<Mahar Ba would take the report, beginning to read it with caution.>

Interesting...
